_about: SYNTHETIC mock model responses for the offline demonstration and tests. They imitate a model that is mostly right but makes realistic mistakes, which the deterministic checks must catch: a fabricated quotation (SYNPUB-002), a followed prompt injection (SYNPUB-002), an affiliation used as a collection site (SYNPUB-001), an overconfident multi-site assignment (SYNPUB-003), and a contrasting sentence read as a collection site (SYNPUB-006, caught by the second-stage check). They are not Claude output and say nothing about Claude's accuracy.
